evidence: Route: explicit code labels + per-item loadings (route 1). S1 Table prints each item against the codes SAU01..SAU08, identical to the S1 Data column headers the processing script keeps verbatim, so every item is tied to its code by label. Independently, paper Table 2 outer loadings vs live first-PC loadings (N=391 complete cases): SAU01 .764/.762, SAU02 .852/.855, SAU03 .827/.829, SAU04 .763/.753, SAU05 .799/.794, SAU06 .709/.713, SAU07 .634/.646, SAU08 .660/.659; max abs diff 0.012, Spearman 1.000; alpha live 0.887 vs published 0.890. The loading route alone does not separate the near-tied SAU01/SAU04 pair (.764 vs .763); the code-label match does.

mapping_basis is data_labels: processing script builds each item code by matching text in the S1 xlsx column header (e.g. "Risk1 - 3." -> risk1_wind_damage), and the header carries the full item wording
